sources.title: occamy-ai/occamy-1.0 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We present Occamy-35B, an efficient agentic model designed for long-horizon decision-making, coordinated multi-tool use, and complex business workflows. Post-trained from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Occamy demonstrates strong stability and task-completion capability on challenging Claw-style tasks.

sources.title: Architecture graph for occamy-ai/occamy-1.0. - hfviewer.com
sources.snippet: occamy-ai/occamy-1.0 architecture at a glance occamy-ai/occamy-1.0 is a text-generation model (qwen3_5_moe_text architecture). It uses 40 transformer layers, a hidden size of 2,048, and 16 query heads with 2 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use a mixture-of-experts design with 256 experts (8 active per token).
